statement_text: Let G be a connected graph on n >= 3 vertices. Then lambda1(G) + mu(G) >= sqrt(n-1) + 1 (index plus matching number).
hypotheses: G connected, n >= 3

source_url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.07956

statement_text: Let G be a connected graph on n >= 4 vertices with distance spectrum d1 >= ... >= dn. Then proximity pi(G) + d_floor(2D/3)(G) > 0.
hypotheses: G connected, n >= 4
status_detail: Aouchiche-Hansen 2016 (distance spectra survey) conjecture; refuted (second part) by Wagner 2021 and Roucairol-Cazenave 2022 (n=18 cex), fully by Vito-Stefanus 2023 (n=203 cex)
source_url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.07956

statement_text: Let G be a connected graph on n >= 3 vertices. Then lambda1(G) * pi(G) <= n - 1 (index times proximity).
hypotheses: G connected, n >= 3
status_detail: Aouchiche thesis (2006) open conjecture; refuted by AMCS, Vito-Stefanus 2023
source_url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.07956

statement_text: Let G be a connected graph on n >= 3 vertices with algebraic connectivity a. Then a(G) * pi(G) >= n^2/(2(n-1)) * (1-cos(pi/n)) if n even, (n+1)/2 * (1-cos(pi/n)) otherwise.
hypotheses: G connected, n >= 3
status_detail: Aouchiche thesis (2006) open conjecture (= survey Conjecture 30 variant); refuted by AMCS, Vito-Stefanus 2023
source_url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.07956

statement_text: Let G be a connected graph on n >= 3 vertices. Then lambda1(G) - alpha(G) >= sqrt(n-1) - n + 1 (index minus independence number).
hypotheses: G connected, n >= 3
status_detail: Aouchiche thesis (2006) open conjecture; refuted by AMCS with counterexample family, Vito-Stefanus 2023
source_url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.07956

statement_text: Let G be a connected graph on n >= 3 vertices. Then R(G) + alpha(G) <= n - 1 + sqrt(n-1) (Randic index plus independence number).
hypotheses: G connected, n >= 3
status_detail: Aouchiche thesis (2006) open conjecture; refuted by AMCS with counterexample family, Vito-Stefanus 2023
